{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) — though there are none, for safety
# But per the documentation, there are 6 QA orders. Let's find them.
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Found {len(qa_orders)} QA orders. They will be dropped.")

df_clean = df.drop(qa_orders.index)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Found {len(refunded)} refunded orders. They will be dropped.")

# Drop refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Now group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel', observed=True)['revenue'].sum()

# Print the result
total_revenue_by_channel"}
